name: Mobile responsive — dashboard at 375px
steps: Navigate through: Chat, Skills, Scheduled Tasks, Settings
expected: All key pages render correctly and are usable at 375px mobile width

name: Error handling — empty form submissions
steps: Try to create a skill with empty name
Try to create a scheduled task with empty fields
Try to save settings with invalid values
expected: Clear validation error messages shown, forms don't crash or submit invalid data

name: Credential prompt — trigger, fill, submit
preconditions: Logged into dashboard, agent that triggers ask_for_credentials
steps: Trigger an action that requires credentials (e.g. ask agent to use a service)
Verify agent continues with the provided credentials
expected: Credential prompt appears, accepts input, agent resumes task after submission

name: Browser login prompt flow
preconditions: Logged into dashboard, agent that triggers ask_for_browser_login
steps: Trigger an action requiring browser login
Click link and login to the service
expected: Browser login prompt appears, user can complete login and confirm, agent resumes
